job.job_title: Python Backend Engineer with strong Cloud expert
job.job_description:
Job Title: Python Backend Engineer (Cloud) Location: Bangalore,Pune Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Python Backend Engineer with strong Cloud expertise to design and develop scalable backend systems and cloud-native applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AWS services, Python (Flask), and Infrastructure as Code tools.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain scalable RESTful APIs using Python and Flask
Design and implement backend services including data handling, authentication, and integrations
Build and manage data pipelines and cloud workflows using AWS services (Lambda, S3, EC2, DynamoDB, SQS)
Automate cloud operations using Boto3
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for provisioning environments
Collaborate with cross-functional teams for deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting
Follow best practices for performance, scalability, and security
Mandatory Skills:
Strong experience in Cloud (AWS preferred)
Preferred Skills:
Python, Flask
AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, DynamoDB, SQS)
Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Docker & CI/CD
Boto3Experience Required:
3–8 years (you can adjust if needed)
Notice Period:
Immediate to 30 days preferred
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and AWS experience, FastAPI transferable to Flask, but lacks Terraform and Docker.
